01Why an operating system

## Most of a clinic's day happens _around_ the visit.

The booking calls. The history taken again from the start. The folder of old reports in three languages. The fee nobody wrote down. None of it is medicine, and all of it lands on the doctor.

Evreon OS gives that work to agents, in one system the whole practice shares. Your hospital software stays the record. Evreon is what gets the work done around it.

![A hospital waiting room with rows of chairs and a numbered queue window](https://evreonai.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fbw%2Fwaiting-room.jpg&w=3840&q=75)![A stethoscope and blood pressure cuff resting on a folded white coat](https://evreonai.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fbw%2Fstethoscope.jpg&w=3840&q=75)The waiting room fills before nine. With Evreon, every paper in it is read before the first patient sits down.

02See the agents at work

## One patient, one day, _four agents._

1. Reception agentA patient asks for a time. The gap is already on screen.Appointments, walk-ins and online consults live in one day that the doctor and the front desk share. Reception shows the doctor's free time, so a booking takes one step, not a round of messages.
2. Intake agentThe history arrives before the patient does.Patients fill in their history at home, in their own language, and upload what they have: old reports, lab results, a photo of a letter.
3. Records agentEvery paper is read and filed.Scanned PDFs, photos, foreign reports. Records reads them all, files them under the patient, and keeps the page each fact came from.
4. The visitOne page, and every line has a source.The doctor opens a one-page case file. Each line is the documents' own words, and a click opens the page it came from. The judgement stays with the doctor.
5. Billing agentThe day closes itself.Every finished visit carries its fee. The month shows what was charged, what came in and what is still open, day by day. No spreadsheet at nine in the evening.

03The agents

## The value starts _the first morning._

Each agent does one job the clinic already does, the way it already does it. Doctors and staff see what every agent did, and can correct any of it.

Live

### Records agent

Reads everything a patient brings and builds a one-page case file. Every line links to the page it came from.

- Scanned PDFs and phone photos
- Documents in 50+ languages
- Files each paper under the right patient
- Keeps the source page for every line

Live

### Intake agent

Collects the history before the visit, in the patient's own language, and keeps their words as written.

- A link the patient opens at home
- Uploads and voice notes
- Arrives in the file before they do

Live

### Reception agent

One day shared by the doctor and the front desk: appointments, walk-ins, online consults.

- The doctor's free time, visible
- Booking in one step
- Roles for secretaries and assistants

Live

### Billing agent

Every finished visit carries its fee. See what was charged, what came in and what is still open.

- Per visit, per day, per month
- Several currencies, kept apart

Coming

### Scribe agent

Listens in the room with the patient's consent and drafts the note for the doctor to edit and sign.

- Consent first
- The doctor edits and signs

04 One system

## Four layers. _One practice._

Scroll slowly. We go down one layer at a time.

01Front of house

### Agents

The agents patients and staff meet. The Receptionist keeps the doctor's day, the Intake questionnaire takes the history before the visit, and each one runs its own workflow.

- Receptionist: the shared day, one-step booking
- Intake questionnaire: the history, at home
- Records: every paper read
- Billing: every visit's fee

02The clinic's own way

### Workflows

The agents run inside how the practice already works: who books, who uploads, who sees what, what gets printed.

- One day for doctor and front desk
- Roles for secretaries and assistants
- Templates in the doctor's words
- Fees per visit, per day

03Every line, sourced

### The record

Underneath the work is the patient's record: every document, every page, every line, each one tied to where it came from.

- Documents in 50+ languages
- One page per patient
- A click opens the source page
- Nothing unsourced goes in

04The ground

### Behind‑the‑scenes agents

At the bottom are the agents nobody sees. They read every upload as it arrives, file it under the right patient, check each line against its page and back everything up at night.

- Every upload read as it arrives
- Filed under the right patient
- Each line checked against its page
- Backed up every night

05Guardrails

## Agents run the clinic. _Never the medicine._

Evreon extracts what the documents say, in their own words, and shows where each line came from. What it means is the physician's call, every time.

**Case file · Jane Doe** Synthetic patient

- Tumour size 2.1 cm, surgical margins clear _Pathology · p.2_
- Ki-67 15% _Pathology · p.2_
- Chest CT: no change since March _Chest · p.1_
- Allergy: penicillin, rash in 2019 _Pre-visit · p.1_

**Pathology report** page 2

Immunohistochemistry: ER positive, PR positive,Ki-67 15%, HER2 score 1+ …

- ~~Diagnose~~ Evreon never names a condition the documents don't.
- ~~Stage or score~~ No staging, no risk scores, no urgency ranking.
- ~~Suggest treatment~~ No drugs, doses or protocols. Ever.
- **Show its sources** Every line opens the page it came from.

![Surgeons at work, seen past the door of operating room 05](https://evreonai.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fbw%2Foperating-room.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

06Built with physicians

## Shaped in the room, _not in a slide deck._

Evreon OS was built beside practising physicians, in their own clinics: what they read first, what they never read, what they would rather not type again. Our clinical advisers cover oncology, cardiology, radiology and neurology.

07Security & trust

## Patient data stays _where it belongs._

[How we handle data](https://evreonai.com/security)

### In its region

Each practice's records are stored in its own region, on infrastructure there.

### Traceable

Every line of a case file is tied to its document and page. Nothing is unsourced.

### By role

A secretary sees the documents a patient brought, not the values inside them.

### Backed up

The database and every document are backed up each night, automatically.

![](https://evreonai.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fbw%2Fhospital-building.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

08Where this goes

## The paperwork of medicine has not changed in seventy years. _The workforce behind it can._

1. Today **The private practice**
One doctor, a front desk, patients from more than one country.

2. Next **The clinic**
Many doctors, shared staff, one day that everyone sees.

3. Then **The hospital**
Agents beside the hospital system, department by department.
